enabled.description: Enables or Disables the traefik integration

forceTLS.description: Force TLS when talking to the backend service Adds the `traefik.ingress.kubernetes.io/service.serversscheme: "https"` annotation.

insecureSkipVerify.description: Skip TLS verification when taling to an HTTPS backend service Allows talking to HTTPS backend services which use self-signed certs.

serverName.description: Set the hostname to use when talking to a backend service

expandObjectName.description: List of kubernetes secrets (in the same namespace) containing certificate authorities to use when performing TLS verification of the backend service.

name.description: Define the configmap name This will be automatically expanded to `fullname-configmap-name`.
Define the secret name This will be automatically expanded to `fullname-secret-name`.

expandObjectName.description: Whether to expand (adding the fullname as prefix) the secret name

rootCAs.description: List of kubernetes secrets (in the same namespace) containing certificate authorities to use when performing TLS verification of the backend service.
